title: Only one on the market
body: This app is good in general but a major flaw is setting the timers doesn’t stop the phone screen from turning off which defeats the purpose of having a visual timer.
author: excusemeimaravenclaw

title: Was great until they cut the number of timers
body:
Seems like a money grab - this was an amazing app. We use it with kids mostly. 

Until they decided to remove the ability to add new timers unless you buy premium.
author: Danny W 927738

title: Time Timer
body:
Great app Esp. for presentations - I would like to have it on my iPad but unfortunately you have to buy it again to get the iPad version

Maybe it would pay to review the marketing strategy as there are competitor apps which are also very good and they don't make you pay twice !  ??
author: PRH61
